title: Technical Exploded
description: Dessin vectoriel isométrique épuré rappelant les schémas techniques et les manuels d'instructions. Il présente des contours noirs uniformes, des lignes de flux en pointillés et des accents de couleurs plates sans ombres sur un fond immaculé.
description_en: Clean, isometric vector line art resembling technical diagrams and instruction manuals. Features uniform black outlines, dashed flow lines, and flat, unshaded color accents on a pristine background.
description_fr: Dessin vectoriel isométrique épuré rappelant les schémas techniques et les manuels d'instructions. Il présente des contours noirs uniformes, des lignes de flux en pointillés et des accents de couleurs plates sans ombres sur un fond immaculé.
prompt: Clean vector technical illustration and exploded view diagram aesthetic, resembling classic instruction manuals or patent drawings. Apply this style to the complete scene described by {{subject}}, preserving its factual content, camera angle, framing, spatial layout, and stated exclusions. The image MUST occupy the absolute ENTIRE dedicated space as a canvas rule: NO borders, NO frames, NO white margins, NO canvas edges, FULL BLEED to all four corners. Execute with clinical draftsmanship using uniform, crisp black outlines of consistent weight to define all structural forms and geometric volumes. The spatial dynamics rely on a pseudo-isometric or axonometric perspective, flattening depth cues while maintaining precise spatial relationships. Rendering is purely flat and graphical: strictly zero gradients, zero shading, zero cast shadows, and no subsurface scattering. Inject flat, highly saturated {{primary_color}} and {{accent_color}} solid vector fills to highlight specific components, contrasting sharply against the uncolored {{secondary_color}} line art sections. Incorporate dashed lines, dotted paths, and subtle schematic arrows to indicate structural connections, assembly axes, or process flow between elements. The texture is flawlessly smooth digital vector art, devoid of film grain, paper fiber, or painterly brushstrokes. The atmosphere is objective, highly legible, and informative. Edges are razor-sharp, with perfect anti-aliasing and zero feathering, creating a stark, high-contrast visual hierarchy. Lighting is entirely ambient and flat, functioning strictly as a blank canvas for the linework rather than a simulated light source. technical illustration, exploded view, isometric diagram, vector line art, uniform black outlines, flat color fills, dashed connection lines, instruction manual aesthetic, flat lighting, crisp edges, full bleed, edge-to-edge, no border, no frame

video.motion: Elements translate linearly along rigid axes (X, Y, Z) mimicking an assembly or disassembly process, guided by the dashed structural lines.
video.camera: Static isometric or orthogonal camera, panning strictly along perfectly horizontal or vertical paths.
video.temporal_texture: Line weight, flat color fills, and crisp vector edges remain perfectly stable with zero jitter, noise, or lighting shifts.
video.avoid: Avoid organic movement, perspective distortion, gradient shifts, depth of field blur, and hand-drawn line boiling.
